forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8480'
+title: 'Stencil: let {% include %} put a file of the skill into the body'
+---
+## What
+An author can write `{% include "references/house-style.md" %}` in `SKILL.md`. The render puts the winning copy of that file of the skill into the body. Now, `{% include %}` finds a file only in the `_partials/` folders of a layer root. That behavior does not change.
+
+Research first:
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Render/StencilPass.swift` calls `StenciledDotfolderStack.render(_:in:)` with `request.winningLayer`, so an include searches only the `_partials/` folder of the layer root.
+- `../FoundationModelsExtras/Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/StenciledDotfolderStack.swift` also has `render(_:at:in:)` (a document path, with a walk from the folder of the document up to the root), and a `partialLocations` list. `TemplateEngine.swift` resolves includes through `DotfolderLoader`.
+- Find out if the Extras API can resolve an include name against the combined view of the skill (`SkillOverlay` / `contributingDirectories`). If it cannot, add the smallest hook in FoundationModelsExtras (for example, a resolver that the caller gives, which is asked first). Make that change in `../FoundationModelsExtras` as its own commit, and pin this package to it. Do not open a file in this package: `Tests/.../SkillsSourceGuardTests` (the "loading boundary" guard) forbids it.
+
+Rules:
+- The order of the search: (1) the combined view of the skill, with the include name as a path relative to the skill; (2) the `_partials/` search of now.
+- The include name must pass `ResourcePathRules.isWellFormedRelativePath(_:)` to use step 1. An absolute name or a name with `..` does not use step 1.
+- The included file is rendered the same as a partial now: the same variables, trust, limits and include-depth limit. An author who wants the text with no template change uses `{% raw %}` in the file. Write this in the docs.
+- An include of a file that is in no step gives the render failure of now.
+- `RenderRequest` must carry the contributing directories of the skill (or an overlay), so `StencilPass` can resolve step 1. Look at `SkillsRegistry.call(id:arguments:)` and where it makes the `RenderRequest`.
+- Docs: `README.md` (the three-pass pipeline text) and `docs/operations.md` or the templating section that names `_partials`: say that an include can name a file of the skill.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A body with `{% include "references/changelog.md" %}` renders with the content of that file.
+- [ ] When a higher layer and a lower layer both hold the file, the include gives the higher-layer copy. A file that only a lower layer holds is found.
+- [ ] `{% include "header.md" %}` from `_partials/` works as now (the `base-style` fixture).
+- [ ] A file of the skill with the same name as a partial wins over the partial.
+- [ ] `{% include "../other-skill/SKILL.md" %}` and an absolute include name do not read a file of a different skill.
+- [ ] A marketplace (untrusted) skill can include its own file, with the untrusted limits.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/StencilPassTests.swift`: tests for each criterion above, over temp layer directories.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/RenderPipelineTests.swift`: one end-to-end render of a fixture skill that includes its own reference.
+- [ ] If Extras changes: a unit test in `../FoundationModelsExtras/Tests` for the new hook.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes with no failure (and `swift test` in `../FoundationModelsExtras` if it changes).
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
